wikipediaArticleRead.support: L115 identifies Sihon as an Amorite king in the Hebrew Bible. This matches the title “Sihon king of the Amorites” at 1 Kings 4:19. The profile does not import the article’s separate Numbers narrative.

sourceTextExcerpts.text: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
